entries.name: Ember Mite
entries.title: Scorched Dross
entries.lore: Clots of ash and failed calcination that skitter out of cracked retorts. Individually brittle, they swarm any warm vessel to strip its mercury.

entries.name: Ember Spitter
entries.title: Slag Bile Vessel
entries.lore: Distended husks engorged on boiling sulfur. They circle the outer kiln perimeter, hurling globules of molten slag whenever a vessel slows its stride.

entries.name: Ember Warden
entries.title: Furnace Overseer
entries.lore: An amalgam of cast-iron ribs and noxious vitriol bound by a regenerating aether ward. Even in death, its ruptured core floods the stones with corrosive bile.

entries.name: Cinder Heart
entries.title: Core of the First Kiln
entries.lore: The living furnace heart that consumed its own alchemists. It awakens only when the Transmutation Circle is charged, determined to melt every vessel back into raw clay.

entries.name: Frost Mite
entries.title: Rime-Bitten Husk
entries.lore: Shards of alchemical salt and frozen mercury thatitters across the dockside stone. Quicker and harder than kiln mites, they hunt in tight, unforgiving packs.

entries.name: Frost Spitter
entries.title: Brine Condenser
entries.lore: Hollowed alembic creatures that siphon freezing brine from the dock fissures and spit high-velocity needles of rime across the chamber.

entries.name: Frost Warden
entries.title: Cryo-Bound Sentinel
entries.lore: Heavy docksidehulks armored in glacier-thick salt plate and shielded by aether. Their touch numbs the vessel's limbs, and their corpse erupts into a pool of caustic brine.

entries.name: Frost Sovereign
entries.title: Regent of the Frozen Dock
entries.lore: An ancient transmutation frozen mid-ascension when the sea-locks broke. Crowned in pale rime, it crushes any vessel that dares open the deeper Rift.

entries.name: Frost Emperor
entries.title: Monarch of Absolute Zero
entries.lore: Entombed at the bottom of the Great Work where heat and motion cease. It is the final seal-keeper; to shatter its glacial hull is to complete the transmutation.

entries.name: Astral Watcher
entries.title: Ocular of the Void
entries.lore: A disembodied brass-and-aether eye that drifts at the edge of sight. It traces a thin celestial sightline before lancing the arena—only solid pillars can break its gaze.
